$comment: SELLER IDENTITY AND LEGAL DISCLOSURE.
Phase 2 step 0 decision: launch as an individual, but keep the Hong Kong
entity reachable as a configuration change rather than a rebuild.
To migrate later, change `activeEntity` from 'individual' to 'hk-sole-prop'
and fill in that profile. Nothing else in the codebase needs to change:
the disclosure block, the checkout provider, the invoice language and the
returns page all read from the active profile.
Anything still marked NEEDS-INPUT is reported by `npm run build` and must be
filled in before the site goes live.
EU Consumer Rights Directive Art. 6(1)(c) requires a geographical address,
a telephone number AND an email address for distance contracts. Other
online channels are an addition, never a substitute. SAMR Order 37 Art. 12
separately requires the real operating address and contact details.
One block satisfies both. All three fields are mandatory.
SAMR Order 37 Art. 8 para 3: an individual doing online trade with
annual turnover not exceeding CNY 100,000 is exempt from 市场主体登记.
Art. 12 then prescribes the EXACT sentence that must be published.
Do not paraphrase the Chinese string — it is quoted from the rule.

selfDeclaration.zh: 个人从事零星小额交易活动，依法不需要办理市场主体登记
selfDeclaration.en: Individual engaged in small-scale, occasional transactions; not required to register as a market entity under PRC law.

$comment: Without a business licence she cannot self-issue 发票. Art. 16 of the
Invoice Management Measures allows 代开 at the tax bureau on request.

note.zh: 默认提供收据。如需发票，可凭交易凭证向经营地税务机关申请代开。
note.en: A receipt is issued by default. A tax invoice (fapiao) can be obtained on request through the local tax authority.

vat.$comment: Monthly sales under CNY 100,000 are VAT-exempt through 2027-12-31.

seller and Airwallex excludes mainland entities from card acquiring,
so cards are not available on this profile. Each artwork carries its
own checkoutUrl in artworks.json; this only declares what is offered.

note.en: Payment is arranged directly. Message or email me and I'll send a secure payment link.
note.zh: 付款方式将直接安排。请联系我，我会发送付款链接。

$comment: Once a HK Business Registration certificate exists, Airwallex can
approve the Payments product, which unlocks international cards PLUS
Alipay and WeChat Pay from one checkout. NOTE: Airwallex approves the
Payments product separately from account opening, and reviews the live
site. Confirm before incorporating.

note.en: An invoice is issued with every order.
Secure checkout. Card, PayPal, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted.
note.zh: 安全结账。支持银行卡、PayPal、支付宝与微信支付。

$comment: A unique pre-existing painting gets NO exception under either regime.
CN: CPL Art. 25 gives 7 days; the exclusions in SAIC Order 90 Arts. 6-7
are a closed list and a pre-existing painting fits none of them. The 2024
Implementing Regulations Art. 19 forbid expanding that list.
EU: CRD Art. 16(c) covers goods made to the consumer's specifications.
Uniqueness is not personalisation.
One worldwide 14-day policy over-satisfies both and avoids geo-detection.
Framed as a personal pledge rather than a per-transaction consumer
promise. State the same basis everywhere - site, receipts, social.
DAP = Delivered at Place. Seller pays freight; buyer handles import
duties and clearance. State it BEFORE checkout, not after payment.
Section 301 List 4A adds 7.5% on HTSUS 9701.91.00 for China-origin
paintings, and the $800 de minimis exemption is suspended. Do NOT
tell US buyers the purchase is duty-free.
usImportNote.en: US buyers: original paintings carry no base import duty, but China-origin works currently attract approximately 7.5% Section 301 duty plus customs handling. Budget roughly 8–12% above the price.
usImportNote.zh: 美国买家：原作本身无基础关税，但中国原产作品目前适用约 7.5% 的 301 条款关税，另加清关手续费，合计约为价格的 8–12%。

ukImportNote.$comment: Verified: 0% duty, ERGA OMNES (origin-neutral), reduced art VAT rate.
ukImportNote.en: UK buyers: no import duty, and original art is charged at the reduced VAT rate.
ukImportNote.zh: 英国买家：无进口关税，原创艺术品适用增值税优惠税率。

euImportNote.$comment: OPEN ITEM - EU reduced art VAT rates unverified; Council Directive (EU) 2022/542 changed art VAT from 2025. Do not publish rates until confirmed.
euImportNote.en: EU buyers: import VAT is charged on arrival at your country's rate for works of art. Any duties or handling fees are payable to the carrier on delivery.
euImportNote.zh: 欧盟买家：进口增值税按贵国艺术品税率于到货时征收。任何关税或手续费须在收货时支付给承运商。
